dwp_revision.title: Benefit fraud and error estimate later restated
dwp_revision.text: DWP's later estimate for a past year differs materially from its earlier published estimate, or falls outside the earlier confidence interval.

dwp_stale.title: Benefit measured long ago
dwp_stale.text: The fraud and error rate for this benefit has not been measured for years, so the published figure may not reflect today's position.

dwp_rate.title: High benefit overpayment rate
dwp_rate.text: A large share of this benefit's spending was overpaid through fraud and error.
